query: How do review themes differ between positive and negative Yelp sentiment?

per_column.name: theme_food_quality
per_column.rationale: Binary presence of a food-quality theme; interpretable and segmentable against sentiment, though its near-even split (130/120) suggests weak separation on its own it is still a valid comparison axis.

per_column.name: theme_service
per_column.rationale: Binary service theme flag; a clear, human-interpretable review dimension that can be cross-tabulated with positive/negative sentiment.

per_column.name: theme_ambiance
per_column.rationale: Ambiance theme flag with well-separated distribution (205/45), giving meaningful segmentation to compare against sentiment.

per_column.name: theme_price_value
per_column.rationale: Price/value theme flag; interpretable category with adequate spread (188/62) for relationship exploration.

per_column.name: theme_wait_time
per_column.rationale: Wait-time theme flag; a distinct, interpretable review topic that can be grouped and compared to sentiment.

per_column.name: theme_repeat_visit
per_column.rationale: Repeat-visit intent flag; interpretable behavioral theme with reasonable spread for cross-tabulation with sentiment.

per_column.name: themes_present
per_column.rationale: A concatenated multi-theme string with many sparse, high-cardinality combinations; too fine-grained to segment meaningfully and largely redundant with the individual theme flags.

per_column.name: theme_count
per_column.rationale: Count of themes present is an interpretable ordinal scale (review richness) that can be compared against sentiment as a distinct dimension from any single theme.

judge.rationale: The individual binary theme flags directly realise the EDA intent: each is an external, interpretable review dimension with well-separated categories that can be grouped and compared against sentiment (label_pos), enabling the exact 'which themes differ by sentiment' analysis requested. Several have strong distributional spread (ambiance, price_value) supporting clear contrasts. theme_count adds an interpretable ordinal summary. The main weakness is themes_present, a high-cardinality concatenated string whose sparse combinations resist meaningful segmentation and merely restate the other flags. Overall a strong, well-targeted exploratory set.
